answer: Anchor each agent identity to two independent chains. Registration locks a $5 bond per chain to one public key, so each identity costs $10 upfront. Each epoch the agent must publish a signed heartbeat on both chains in 15 min; one chain alone freezes the identity and forfeits both bonds. A violet flag marks identities with disagreeing heartbeats, a signal every requester sees before hiring. One hundred fakes need 200 bonds, $1,000 locked, plus 200 heartbeats at $0.02 each, $4 per epoch. Trust ends at the horizon where chains stop agreeing, like a bridge standing only if both banks hold.
